Ravi (Product): Kickoff: need a concise MVP for audit exports + BYO-key support we can show customers this quarter. Goals: clear acceptance tests, rough ETA, and handoff owners.

June (Eng): Engineering constraints: signed exports + retention enforcement are top priorities. BYOK increases onboarding surface but can be opt-in. Suggest MVP: 30/365 retention lanes, managed-KMS default, BYOK opt-in (no HSM at GA).

Omar (Security): Security asks: signed manifest, per-file checksums, KMS-audit-id in manifest. BYOK handshake must prove no plaintext exposure. Will draft threat checklist.

Priya (Sales): Two pilots need 7y archival and legal-hold. They'll pay for archival storage and concierge onboarding. Need export SLA (we propose 24h standard, 6h expedited).

Liam (Legal): We'll need BYOK contract clause and legal-hold process. Also confirm we can pause TTLs only on validated legal-hold requests.

CS Bot: Runbook template created: /cs/runbooks/evidence-export-template (draft).

June (Eng): Proposed acceptance tests: 1) 90-day sample export returns signed-manifest + bundle with checksums; 2) applying legal-hold prevents purge; 3) BYOK handshake completes without Redwood plaintext access.

Omar (Security): Add: manifest signature verifiable with our published public key; include example openssl verification in docs.

Ravi (Product): Owners: June -> tech spec + cost delta by EOW, Omar -> threat checklist in 1w, Priya -> pilot contacts + residency needs, Liam -> draft legal clause in 5d. Follow-up sync Thu 09:00. :thumbsup:
__notes: Slack thread single text field; messages chronological; no title field.
